## 💡 Feature Summary

A clear, one-line summary of the feature you're requesting.

---

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

What problem or frustration does this feature address? Why do you need it?

> Example: "As a student, I find it hard to see all my pending tasks for the week in one place because..."

---

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like this feature to work. Be as specific as possible.

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches or workarounds? Why did you prefer this solution?

---

## 📍 Platform

Where should this feature be added?
- [ ] 🌐 Web App
- [ ] 📱 Android App
- [ ] ⚙️ Backend API
- [ ] 🤖 AI Assistant
- [ ] All platforms

---

## 👥 Who Benefits

Who would use this feature?
- [ ] All users
- [ ] Students
- [ ] Professionals
- [ ] Developers / API users
- [ ] Other: ___

---

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If you have a sketch, wireframe, or reference to another app that does something similar, share it here.

---

## 📎 Additional Context

Any other context, links, or information about the feature request.
